- Date : July 18 2026, 7:16 pm 
- Author : Logistics Monitor 

CEVA Logistics, a global leader in third-party logistics, has announced the opening of a new large-scale warehouse operation in Derby, UK, marking another significant milestone for the company and further strengthening its position as a strategic logistics partner for leading global eCommerce brands.

Supporting regional eCommerce Growth 

CEVA will operate the new 508,000-square-foot warehouse facility in Derby to manage the storage, handling and distribution of customer inventory, enabling faster, more efficient customer deliveries across the UK. # VB Distribution opens new Lancashire warehouse complex 

 Jordan Taylor July 24, 2026

Darwen, Lancashire Jul 24, 2026 (EMWNews.com) – VB Distribution has opened its new business park in Lancashire, adding 100,000 sq. ft of bonded warehousing and trade counter capacity to its national network of depots, now totalling 500,000 sq. ft across the country. The site marks the latest milestone in the group’s long-term expansion programme, and cements its position as the market leader ahead of the sector’s biggest regulatory shift in a decade.

The site expands the group’s HMRC-approved customs bonded warehouse operation, one of the few in the sector, allowing duty-suspended storage at a scale others cannot match. With the Vaping Products Duty taking effect on 1 October 2026, bonded capacity shapes who can hold stock, manage duty cash flow and keep retailers supplied without price shocks.

SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion · BUSINESSFIRST

# SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion

 September 7, 2026 

 

SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

The new facility takes the company’s total warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland to 83,500 sq ft, up from 37,500 sq ft at its Kilkeel base. The additional capacity will support larger fulfilment contracts across the fashion, wellness and beauty sectors, while marking the launch of a new 10-year growth strategy targeting revenues of £50 million by 2036. Five full-time employees have already been recruited at the new site, with a further 20 permanent roles expected to be created over the next three years. An additional 10 seasonal positions will be added this winter.

## SJH Fulfilment

The company has also secured a significant contract for the site with a multi-billion-dollar US-based brand, which is consolidating its Great Britain and EU warehousing operations through Northern Ireland

results.author: Mark Brown
results.text:
Amazon to set up 'logistics site' in Mill Hill - Barnet Post

# Amazon to set up ‘logistics site’ in Mill Hill

11 August, 2026 12:53 pm 1 Min Read

The company says the delivery station at Pentavia Retail Park will create 80 jobs when it opens in October

An Amazon delivery station – (Credit – Amazon)

An online giant says it is “excited” to be investing in Mill Hill as it prepares to open a new delivery station in October.

Amazon will open the 100,000 square foot site at Pentavia Retail Park in Mill Hill and says it will bring “approximately 80 new jobs” to the area. 

The company says that salaries for “full time on-site roles” start at £31,824 a year. 

They say the site will serve customers across the Barnet area and will also create “hundreds of additional driver opportunities” through its delivery service partners programme. 

Prajvin Prakash, country director for Amazon Logistics, said: “We’re excited to be investing in this area with a new delivery station that will create permanent roles for the local workforce here, and help us deliver even faster for customers.”

# Online grocer Ocado Retail secures last mile fulfilment centre in Stoke

Posted on Tuesday 21 July 2026 Share: 

Online grocer Ocado has secured a last mile fulfilment centre at developer investor Indurent’s Indurent Park Stoke Central scheme in the West Midlands.

By Liza Helps, Property Editor, Logistics Matters

OCADO HAS taken unit C55 – the last available warehouse on the 530,000 ft2 Stoke Central development – on a 15-year lease at a rent thought to be close to the asking rent of circa £524,700 per year (£9.49 per ft2).

The facility which totals 55,232 ft2 features 10m eavesand a floor loading capacity of 50kN per m2. It has 48,355 ft2 of warehouse space with five dock and two level access doors served by a 50m yard with parking for seven HGVs.

The building also benefits form 3,714 ft2 of office space as well as a 3,136 ft2 plant deck. It was built to achieve BREEAM Excellent and an EPC A rating.

The building also incorporates rooftop solar PV and EV charging infrastructure, which Ocado will use to house, maintain and charge its growing fleet of electric delivery vehicles.

In Your Area Ian Bunting

Route2 owner Joe Wall and operations manager Rodger Caldwell

Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland.

Published 18th Aug 2026, 04:30 BST

## The new facility is expected to begin operating early next year 

Lidl has opened recruitment for hundreds of warehouse jobs at its new £150m distribution centre in Leeds.

The supermarket giant is looking to fill full and part-time warehouse operative positions at its new facility in Gildersome, with successful applicants potentially starting work before Christmas.

The recruitment drive marks the latest stage of Lidl's investment in the West Yorkshire site, which is expected to begin operating early next year.

Warehouse operative roles start at £13.80 an hour, rising to £14.45 with length of service.
